Movement away from the midline of the body (such as raising arms horizontally to the side) (frontal plane)
Movement toward the midline of the body (such as lowering raised arms horizontally) (frontal plane)
circular movement about a joint by combining movements in all degrees of freedom of movement (such as in the shoulder, hip and about a fixed point in the trunk)
movement of the foot towards the anterior tibia b. at the talocrural j. (sagittal plane)
movement of the foot away from the anterior tibia b. at the talocrural j. (sagittal plane)
turning the sole of the foot outward so that the heal and big toe move laterally out and away from the neutral position (frontal plane)
turning the sole of the foot inward so that the heal and big toe move medially from the neutral position (frontal plane)
motion increasing the angle of a joint by moving bones apart, or straightening
motion decreasing the angle of a joint by moving bones closer, or bending
rotation of the hands and forearms so that the palms face downward
rotation of the hands and forearms so that the palms face upward
rotation in the transverse plane toward the midline of the body
rotation in the transverse plane away from the midline of the body
